# Agents

See [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md) for repository instructions. Claude Code loads each rule file of `.claude/rules/` when it
works on a file that matches the paths of the rule. Other agents read the rule file themselves before such a change:

<!-- Generated by gradle ruleIndex from the front matter of .claude/rules/*.md. -->
| Rule file | Read it before you change | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `.claude/rules/api.md` | `api/**` | the controllers, the acting user, the DTOs, and the error responses. |
| `.claude/rules/build.md` | `**/*.gradle.kts`, `build-logic/**`, `gradle/**`, `gradle.properties`, `mise.toml`, `.github/**`, `config/**`, `detekt-rules/**`, `coverage/**`, `scripts/**` | the build scripts, CI, and the thresholds of coverage, mutation tests, and duplicates. |
| `.claude/rules/data.md` | `data/**` | the migrations, the JPA entities, the data adapters, and the entity mappers. |
| `.claude/rules/domain.md` | `domain/**` | the ports, the value rules, the locks, and the models that follow a domain model. |
| `.claude/rules/later-features.md` | `requirements/**`, `domain/src/main/kotlin/de/seuhd/campuscoffee/domain/model/**`, `domain/src/main/kotlin/de/seuhd/campuscoffee/domain/ports/data/**`, `data/src/main/**` | the tables of later features and the rules for money (FR-4 to FR-6, FR-10 to FR-12, FR-15 to FR-19). |
| `.claude/rules/models.md` | `models/**`, `doc/statecharts/**`, `doc/class-diagrams/**` | the TLA+ and Alloy models, with `models/README.md` and `.claude/skills/statechart/SKILL.md`. |
| `.claude/rules/new-entity.md` | `domain/src/main/kotlin/de/seuhd/campuscoffee/domain/model/**`, `domain/src/main/kotlin/de/seuhd/campuscoffee/domain/ports/**`, `data/src/main/resources/db/migration/**`, `data/src/main/kotlin/de/seuhd/campuscoffee/data/persistence/**` | the steps to add an entity across the modules. |
| `.claude/rules/requirements.md` | `requirements/**` | the IDs, the key words, and the sources of the numbers in `requirements/`. |
| `.claude/rules/tests.md` | `**/src/test/**`, `**/src/testFixtures/**` | the test levels, the requests of the system tests, the test fixtures, and the test names. |
<!-- End of the generated list. -->
